title: wuyoscar/GPT-Image2-Skill
claim: wuyoscar/GPT-Image2-Skill — GPT Image 2 prompt gallery, image prompt library, agentic skill, and CLI for OpenAI image generation/editing
why_good: A prompt gallery + skill + CLI for GPT Image 2 — handy for creators, but a prompt collection wrapped around someone else's model.
value: Prompt galleries are hard to monetize; at best a paid pack, but the value is content that models absorb.
risk: Content/skill wrapper dependent on OpenAI's image model; near-zero moat and easily cloned.

zh.claim: wuyoscar/GPT-Image2-Skill —— GPT Image 2 的提示词画廊、图像提示库、智能体技能与 CLI。
zh.why_good: GPT Image 2 的提示词画廊 + 技能 + CLI——对创作者方便,但它是围着别人模型的提示词合集。
zh.value: 提示词画廊很难变现;顶多卖个包,但价值是会被模型吸收的内容。
zh.risk: 依附 OpenAI 图像模型的内容/技能封装;护城河近乎为零、易被抄。
